headline: Findlay's unbeaten run ends at Kentucky Wesleyan
dek: Findlay had won all four of their matches before Saturday, when Kentucky Wesleyan beat them for the first defeat of Findlay's season. Cedarville and Tiffin, each still unbeaten in conference play, now share the top of the table, and Cedarville, who had not scored a week ago, have found the net in every conference match since.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Lake Erie have scored twelve, level with Thomas More at the top of the chart, but have conceded nine, and their record of two wins, two draws and two defeats says the goals are going in at both ends.

wire.line: Findlay's defeat at Kentucky Wesleyan leaves no unbeaten side; Cedarville and Tiffin top the table with perfect conference records.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Five matches have gone past their date with no published result. Kentucky Wesleyan account for most of them, and Walsh's visit to Pitt-Johnstown is the other.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Ashland have conceded twelve goals, more than any other programme, and have lost four times and won once, at Millersville.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Tiffin have conceded four goals all season and have lost only once, at home to Charleston on the opening day; since then they have won three and drawn two.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Ethan Hensley has conceded four goals for Findlay and kept two clean sheets, with thirteen saves and a save percentage of .765.

last_match.line: Findlay had won every match before this; Kentucky Wesleyan had lost at home to Lake Erie in midweek.

next_match.line: Tiffin have lost only on the opening day; Findlay arrive off their first defeat of the season.
